thread:
acme-dev: hitting 403 on GitHub SSO callback after consent. users see `OauthError: state_mismatch`. Happened since ~10:40am PST
support-anne: sorry — can you paste the full callback URL (with code redacted) and a request id from our logs?
acme-dev: callback: `https://app.acme.com/auth/callback?code=...&state=abc+123%2Fxyz` request id `req_0a1b2c`
server log: `oauth: state mismatch, expected "abc%2B123%2Fxyz" got "abc 123/xyz"`
support-anne: hmm looks like `+` -> space decode issue. Are you behind a proxy that might be normalizing query string? cloudflare worker or custom edge rewrites?
acme-dev: yes, our edge worker canonicalizes QS for routing. we shipped a tiny change yesterday to canonicalize encoded chars. suspecting that.
eng-raj: confirm: GitHub returns `state` as a query param that must be compared raw after percent-decoding. If the proxy runs `decodeURIComponent` or converts `+` to space, PKCE/state will fail. can you grep the worker for `URLSearchParams` or any manual decode?
sre-lucy: deploy-bot shows a patch `edge-canonicalize-qs` rolled at 09:58 which switched from `rawQuery` passthrough to `new URL(url).searchParams.toString()` -> that will normalize `+` to space.
support-anne: short-term workaround: ensure the `state` uses a URL-safe encoding. e.g. `state = encodeURIComponent(base64url(state))` or just `state = base64url(state)` — avoid `+` and `/`. also `encodeURIComponent` on the final redirect helps.
acme-dev: trying the client encode now (will push a quick patch to the web client). can you revert the edge change and confirm afterward?
deploy-bot: rollback `edge-canonicalize-qs` initiated by @sre-lucy at 11:05 UTC. status: in progress.
eng-raj: after rollback we'll re-run repro with your `req_0a1b2c` and check the logs for `state` values. also adding a CI test for `+`->space canonicalization on edge.
acme-dev: quick test from my machine: encoded state `YWJjKzEyMy14eXo` (base64url) — login flow now completes, no 403. thanks.
support-anne: great. ETA for rollback finish ~15–30m; if you can keep the temporary client encode in place for 24h that avoids user impact. :thumbsup:
acme-dev: will do. appreciate the fast turnaround.
eng-raj: follow-up items: 1) revert patch fully or change to preserve raw query string, 2) add regression test in edge repo, 3) docs note about using URL-safe `state` for PKCE flows.
sre-lucy: rollback finished at 11:18 UTC, logs show incoming callback `state=abc%2B123%2Fxyz` and server now matches expected value.
acme-dev: confirmed, users report successful logins again. thanks all! :tada:
